name: @scalemule/ai
description: ScaleMule AI facade client: typed, durable AI runs over /v1/ai (summarize and friends). Framework-neutral, zero dependencies.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const v=require('./package.json').version; if(!/^0\.(0|1)\.\d+$/.test(v)){console.error('ERR: SDK '+v+' violates patch-only policy (0.0.x or 0.1.x only). See CONTRIBUTING.md SDK versioning section.');process.exit(1)}" && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.release: npm run prepublishOnly && npm publish --access public
